## TabStation 2.17.1

- New screenshots on the website (desktop with widgets, Edit Widgets, Control Center, Spotlight, Launchpad).
- Fixed: the menu bar could show a raw package name (e.g. after a permission dialog) instead of the app name or "TabStation".
- Fixed: apps opened from Spotlight now open after Spotlight has fully closed.
- From 2.17.0: English and Bahasa Indonesia, keyboard shortcuts, arrangeable widgets, Snap Layouts, loading screens and a clean lock screen. See the 2.17.0 notes for the full list and the shortcut table.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. On HyperOS, allow Autostart for TabStation so it comes back after an update.

## TabStation 2.17.0

**Language**
- Bahasa Indonesia or English, chosen before TabStation is switched on (in the "Extra features" dialog) or any time in Settings → Bahasa / Language. Covers the menu bar, Dock/taskbar, Start, Launchpad, Control Center, widgets, Spotlight, dialogs, Settings and the setup guide.

**macOS desktop**
- Desktop widgets: Calendar, Weather, World Clock, Stocks and Screen Time. Press and hold a widget to move it (it lifts, follows your finger and snaps to the nearest free spot). Edit Widgets mode adds a "−" badge to remove and a gallery to add widgets. Positions are saved.
- Spotlight: menu bar 🔍 or Alt+Space. Finds apps and system settings, calculates ("120+35*2", "15% x 230") and searches the web.
- Separate TabStation wallpaper per theme; the HyperOS home and lock screen wallpaper are left alone. Set it from the desktop menu or Gallery → Set as → TabStation wallpaper.
- Hot Corners (mouse): Launchpad, desktop, Control Center, Notification Center, Spotlight or lock. Off by default.

**Both themes**
- Snap Layouts: hold (or hover with a mouse) the ▢ button / green light to place the window in halves, ⅔ + ⅓, thirds or quarters.
- Loading screens when TabStation starts and shuts down (macOS progress bar, Windows spinner); the navigation bar no longer flickers during the switch.
- Launch screen for full-screen apps that take a while to appear (e.g. WPS for PC), with a hard time limit and a Skip button.
- Lock screen from the logo menu (macOS), the power menu in Start (Windows), Ctrl+Alt+L or a hot corner. Uses the normal HyperOS lock. Floating windows are noted first and hidden behind the desktop so the lock screen stays clean, then restored as they were after unlocking (also after the screen times out).
- Refresh in the Windows desktop menu: re-attaches the taskbar, reloads apps and re-checks navigation without a restart.
- Alt/Win+Tab is left to HyperOS Recents; the Dock and menu bar step aside while Recents is open.

**Keyboard shortcuts** (physical keyboard, Shizuku; chosen so they don't clash with HyperOS or Android)

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| Alt + Space | Spotlight (macOS) / Search (Windows) |
| Alt + ` (Shift = back) | TabStation window switcher, minimized windows included |
| Ctrl + Alt + A | Launchpad / Start |
| Ctrl + Alt + D | Show desktop |
| Ctrl + Alt + E | File manager |
| Ctrl + Alt + C | Control Center / Quick Settings |
| Ctrl + Alt + N | Notification Center |
| Ctrl + Alt + ← / → | Window to the left / right half |
| Ctrl + Alt + ↑ / ↓ | Full screen / minimize |
| Ctrl + Alt + Q | Close the app |
| Ctrl + Alt + R | Refresh |
| Ctrl + Alt + L | Lock screen |

On a Mac-style keyboard Ctrl = ⌃ and Alt = ⌥. HyperOS keeps Alt/Win + Tab, Win + arrows and Win + letters. Keys are still delivered to the app in front.

**Memory**
- "Extra features" can be chosen each time you switch TabStation on (widgets, TabStation wallpaper, preloading Launchpad, keyboard shortcuts), each with its approximate memory cost.
- Launchpad icons and widget data load after the loading screen instead of during start-up.

**Fixes**
- "Never sleep" now holds even while a full-screen app hides the Dock (the screen used to lock after the tablet's own timeout).
- HyperOS navigation could stay on three buttons after switching TabStation off.
- Installing an app update or changing the HyperOS wallpaper no longer reloads every icon dozens of times (CPU spike and flicker).
- Menu bar and Dock no longer disappear behind an app that shows a full-screen transparent window while loading.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. On HyperOS, allow Autostart for TabStation so it comes back after an update.
